name: adb Mac key self-heal
purpose: Restores the Mac's adb public key (macback@macback.local) to /data/misc/adb/adb_keys at boot (Magisk service.d) and on each powos-periodic pass (every 10 min) if the phone drops it. Append-only, that one key only. Fixes the 2026-11-08 lockout where the dropped key blocked all phone work for ~8h. The key alone is not enough on this Oplus phone: the framework re-prompts "Allow USB debugging?" unless "Always allow" was ticked (docs/REMOTE-POWOS.md, adb authorization).
installedBy: targets/android/rooted/powos-deploy.sh (written live by the manager 2026-11-08; the repo copy is the same bytes)
